summaryZh: S2ML lab 运用数学与计算设计具有可证明保证的机器学习算法，并处理人工智能时代的数据隐私和滥用预防问题。近期主题包括生成式人工智能水印、差分隐私、离线与在线强化学习及深度学习适应性理论。

evidence.quote: So what do we do in S2ML lab? Broadly speaking, my students and I apply math and computing to (1) design faster, stronger and more efficient ML algorithms with provable guarantees (2) solve societal challenges (e.g., data privacy, abuse prevention) that emerge in the AI era. Our recent focus include watermarking generative AI, making differential privacy practical, bridging offline and online RL, developing a theory of adaptivity in deep learning.
I am a faculty member of the Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute at UC San Diego, also affliated with the CSE department.
